comment: One row per asset Blender makes (#801 to #808). `npm run blender:render <pack>` runs tools/blender/packs/<script> once per row, on one of Devon's machines with Blender 5.2, and writes assets/blender/<pack>/<name>.glb and its tools/blender/manifest.json row. Every key of a row is in its source hash, so editing a row without a render is check 8 line 4. `packs.<pack>.extraColours` is at most 8 colours outside tools/pixel/textures.json's palettes, each with a `why`.

extraColours.why: Tallow. The candle-count quest and the chapel candle clue are tallow candles, and the castle's palettes stop at plaster #cbbfa3, which reads as stone beside a wall of it, not as a candle.
Wheat, and the rick. The castle's palettes have no yellow above plaster #cbbfa3 and wooden_gate's browns, so a field of standing corn at 60 m in the fog would read as bare earth or as stone.

Meadow. Every green in tools/pixel/textures.json is forest_ground_06 or grassy_cobblestone, moss and shade at most #5b6a36, and a hay meadow beside a ploughed strip needs one green lighter than the slopes behind it, or the fields are one colour under fog.
Thatch, for the longhouse and barn roofs. The castle roofs are slate and tile, and a farm under a slate roof reads as a second castle at 100 m.

rows.name: crate
rows.why: The pipeline's proof end to end (#808): a store crate of planks and two battens, placed once in the larder.

rows.name: aumbry-candles
rows.why: Dresses the candle-count quest (four tallow in the aumbry at Compline, three at Lauds) and data/lore.json's candle account; the three that are left, at 26, 22 and 18 cm. Not pressable, so no clue (#810).

rows.name: pricket
rows.why: Swaps for the `candle` evidence, `candles-chapel` (#811): one tallow candle in a pricket at the first turn of the Chapel Tower stair, wax pooled below it. The photoscanned brass candleholders it replaces were three candlesticks in a 1.08 m spread and 41,936 triangles.

rows.name: knife-barrel
rows.why: Swaps for the `knife` evidence (#811), a herring: the kitchen knife, in the bakehouse, flour on it. A flour barrel with the knife stuck in the flour and its handle over the rim, in place of a kit barrel.

rows.name: ledger-desk
rows.why: Swaps for the `ledger` evidence, `table-muniment` (#811): the works ledger open on a desk in the muniment room, 340 sheets received and 212 laid, in place of a photoscanned table with nothing on it.

rows.name: backdrop-north
rows.why: North of the base ground, the whole north walk's view: fields under the wall, two farmsteads, woods on the slopes and the rim at z -170. One of five pieces cut from one height field (#817); placed as interiorProps `backdrop-north`, backdrop and noCollide.

rows.name: backdrop-south
rows.why: South of the base ground: fields, two farmsteads and the rim at z 170. One of five pieces cut from one height field (#817); placed as interiorProps `backdrop-south`, backdrop and noCollide.

rows.name: backdrop-east
rows.why: East of the base ground, between the north and south pieces: fields running out to the rim at x 180. One of five pieces cut from one height field (#817); placed as interiorProps `backdrop-east`, backdrop and noCollide.

rows.name: backdrop-north-west
rows.why: North of outside-ground, beside the town: woods and the rim along the river's line at x -140, so the north end of the river runs under a hill and not into nothing. One of five pieces cut from one height field (#817); placed as interiorProps `backdrop-north-west`, backdrop and noCollide.

rows.name: backdrop-south-west
rows.why: South of outside-ground: one farmstead and the rim, as the north-west piece. One of five pieces cut from one height field (#817); placed as interiorProps `backdrop-south-west`, backdrop and noCollide.
